messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] 2026-11-03T01:47:07Z - service=inference-api.eu-west-1 - sudden spike in 5xx and median latency. Autoscaling triggered; paging on-call.
Ajay K.: ack. jumping in. Any recent deploys or config changes?
incident-bot: no deploys in last 45m. Noted high KV eviction rate on nodepool-gpu-b. Autoscaler added 2 nodes at 01:50 UTC.
Maria T.: seeing OOM-ish traces in kv_cache and many eviction logs. snippet:
```
2026-11-03T01:46:59Z ERROR kv_cache.cc:198 evict failed: memory_pressure
2026-11-03T01:47:00Z WARN runtime: retrying request due to cache miss causing recompile
```
Maria T.: I'm initiating a temporary vertical scale on the affected pool and will also quarantine heavy prefix-populate traffic. Requesting approval to take region-failover action for selected customers to us-west-2 for up to 25 minutes.
Ajay K.: approve. Lucas, can you validate cross-region routing and any IP restrictions?
Lucas O. (SRE): peering and routing tables OK. I'll flip the routing policy for non-pinned customers; pinned accounts will remain on eu-west-1 unless they opt in. Monitoring QPS/5xx.
pagerduty-bot: Acknowledged by Ajay K. at 01:51 UTC. Estimated impacted surface: ~15% of eu-west-1 traffic, with ~10 dedicated customers pinned.
Sarah C. (CS): creating case list for impacted accounts. Prioritizing enterprise and active SLA customers for one-off outreach.
Ajay K.: mitigation: scaled nodepool at 01:53, routing partial failover in place at 01:55, error rate returning to baseline by 02:02. Keeping watch for 30m. Adding short incident summary to thread.
Ajay K.: preliminary RCA: unbounded prefix-populate job (partner-account-786) caused sustained KV population leading to cache pressure on subset of nodes; eviction storms produced dozens of downstream 5xx. No infra deploys immediately before incident.
Maria T.: quarantined partner job and added backpressure. Also patched the populate job to respect kv-cache free-memory threshold.
Natalie P. (Product): what customer-facing severity do we classify? Is this S2 or S3? Do we need proactive credits messaging?
Sarah C.: marking as S2 (degraded) for affected customers. I will draft targeted messages for top 15 customers and one general status update for status.redwood.ai.
Ajay K.: I'll spin up the postmortem doc and schedule a follow-up sync. Proposed postmortem: 2026-11-03 09:30 UTC. Please add stakeholders: ops, product, cs, finance. Evan, please join for billing impact.
Evan (Finance): on standby. Need precise affected window and account list to compute pro-rated SLA credits. Provide the request id ranges and per-account monthly commit.
Ajay K.: timeline saved to doc (internal link). Key timestamps: incident detection 01:47 UTC, mitigation actions 01:53-01:55 UTC, recovery 02:02 UTC. For crediting purposes we'll treat the impact window as 01:47-02:02 (15 minutes) for pinned customers and 01:55-02:02 (7 minutes) for non-pinned routed customers.
Maria T.: assigning follow-ups: TASK-101 (Maria): add throttle/guardrail to prefix-populate workloads to cap concurrent inserts. ETA 2026-11-18. TASK-102 (Lucas): create alert for kv-eviction-rate > threshold and add runbook. ETA 2026-11-12. TASK-103 (Ajay): review routing policies and test faster cutovers in staging. ETA 2026-11-22.
Ajay K.: I'm handing off to Lucas for the rest of the shift (30m). Handoff note: issue mitigated, monitoring green, postmortem scheduled, CS/Finance looped.
--- postmortem recap (same day) ---
Ajay K.: outcome from the postmortem: confirmed root cause = unbounded prefix-populate; contributing factors = lack of eviction-rate alert, no populate backpressure, routing policy tail latency for pinned traffic. Action items consolidated in doc.
Sarah C. (CS): customer outreach: sent personalized emails to top 15 accounts at 08:20 UTC. Two customers asked for SLA credit estimates. No urgent escalations.
Evan (Finance): SLA credit methodology: pro-rate based on monthly_commit and impacted minutes. Example calc: monthly minutes = 30d * 24h * 60m = 43200 minutes. If SLA allows 99.9% uptime, allowed downtime per month = 43.2 minutes. For our purposes we compute credit as (impacted_minutes / (30*24*60)) * monthly_commit. For a dedicated customer with $9,000/month commit and 15 impacted minutes: credit = (15/43200)*9000 ≈ $3.125 -> round to cents.
Evan (Finance): sample query to fetch candidates:
```
SELECT account_id, invoice_id, monthly_commit_cents, pinned_region
FROM billing.accounts
WHERE pinned_region = 'eu-west-1'
AND active = true
AND billing_period_start = '2026-11-01';
```
Evan (Finance): also need per-account error_rate during windows to determine eligibility buckets (>0.5%, >5%, >20%). Maria, can you export per-account metrics for request_id ranges 1795600000-1795609999?
Maria T.: will export the metrics and attach to the postmortem folder.
Evan (Finance): once I have the list I'll prepare a CSV with columns: account_id, invoice_id, impacted_minutes, monthly_commit_cents, credit_amount_cents, expedite_flag, incident_id. Billing-ops will post negative line items tagged incident-1795604827. GL mapping: incident-credits expense account.
Sarah C. (CS): draft customer-facing message for SLA credits:
"We briefly experienced degraded service in eu-west-1 on 2026-11-03 between 01:47-02:02 UTC. If you are eligible under our SLA, we will apply pro-rated credits to your next invoice. Reply to this message if you'd like an estimate sooner and we'll prioritize it."
Ajay K.: TASK-104 (Evan): produce the credit CSV and confirm billing-ops workflow. ETA 2026-11-10. TASK-105 (Sarah): finalize customer comms post-confirmation. ETA 2026-11-11. TASK-106 (Lucas): schedule stress test of prefix-populate with guardrails in staging. ETA 2026-11-17.
Evan (Finance): billing note: credits entered as negative invoice adjustment with metadata "incident-1795604827". Billing-ops, please ensure credits are visible in customer invoice history and that expedited ones are applied in the current billing window if requested.
pagerduty-bot: Incident closed by Ajay K. at 02:18 UTC. Postmortem meeting complete and tasks assigned.
Evan (Finance): uploaded draft CSV to shared drive: /finance/incident-1795604827/credits-draft.csv. I'll attach final CSV to the support ticket and notify CS to include amounts in customer replies.
Sarah C. (CS): three customers requested expedited credits. Evan, please mark expedite_flag for those rows.
Evan (Finance): acknowledge. Will prioritize and notify billing-ops.
Ajay K.: closing operational thread. Finance and CS continue here for billing artifacts and customer replies. If any disputes arise, escalate to me and tag #billing. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
(End of thread)
